minutes.headline: Committee approved line-item transfers for a new high school transitions program and accepted a memorial bench donation.
minutes.summary: The committee accepted a memorial buddy bench donation, heard three line-item transfers funding a high school transitions program, waived second reading of two policies, appointed a calendar advisory committee, and approved a Unitil easement. It reviewed FY16 capital items with members pressing for more options on the asbestos abatement. Principals presented MCAS results, and a resident raised the Passios building and land, district offices and student computers.

public_comment.topic: Protecting the Kana Lawrence playground, status of the Passios building and land, district office relocation, Brooks House, buddy programs, and a plan for computers for every student.

votes.motion: Accept the buddy bench donation in memory of Bob
Waive second reading of the fingerprinting and bullying and harassment policies
Appoint the calendar advisory committee volunteers as a slate, adding student representatives
Approve the Unitil easement agreement and authorize the superintendent as signatory
Acknowledge the Walmart and Target donations with gratitude

what_happened.line: The committee voted to approve the Unitil easement agreement and authorize the superintendent to sign it.
The FY16 capital plan was sent back for rework: members asked for more options on asbestos abatement at the middle school and on phone and intercom savings.
Members heard three line-item transfers that move money from out-of-district tuition lines to pay for a high school transitions program.
The committee accepted a memorial buddy bench donation for the primary school, waived second reading of two policies, and appointed a calendar advisory committee.
The committee voted to acknowledge donations from Walmart and Target, which support a robotics program and the high school.

why_it_matters: The capital plan sets what the district asks the town to fund in FY16, so how abatement, technology and the district office move are spread across years affects future tax bills.
The transitions program shifts money from tuition for students placed outside the district to staff inside the high school, which changes where special education dollars are spent.
watch_next: The revised capital plan is due back at the October 15 meeting, ahead of the 17th deadline.
A goal setting workshop is to be scheduled after the Tuesday workshop.
